claims.claim: The European Union proposed new legislation targeting deceptive designs, influencer marketing and artificial intelligence in online consumer protection.
claims.episode_span: The European Union put forward draft legislation that would ban certain deceptive website designs, require clearer disclosure from influencers, and set limits on how companies can use artificial intelligence to target consumers.
claims.source_title: EU Lays Out Plan to Tighten Online Consumer Protection Rules
claims.supporting_quote: The European Union proposed new legislation to tighten its online consumer protection rules, targeting deceptive designs, influencer marketing and artificial intelligence.

claims.claim: Imran Khan was taken overnight from Adiala Jail to Pakistan Institute of Medical Sciences for an eye injection and returned to prison.
claims.episode_span: Imran Khan’s party demanded that family members and personal doctors be allowed to visit him after he was taken overnight from prison to a government hospital for an eye injection and then returned to his cell.
claims.source_title: Pakistan’s PTI demands access to jailed Khan after overnight hospital visit
claims.supporting_quote: Khan, 74, briefly left the Adiala Jail in Rawalpindi for an eye examination at Islamabad’s Pakistan Institute of Medical Sciences (PIMS), the government hospital said on Wednesday.

claims.claim: Residents of the destroyed market town of Dhunge face difficult questions about where to rebuild.
claims.episode_span: Christian Science Monitor — residents of the destroyed market town of Dhunge weigh whether to rebuild on the same site.
claims.supporting_quote: its residents face difficult questions about how – and where – to rebuild.

claims.claim: Swatters use AI technology that creates synthetic voices to generate remarkably believable fake emergency calls.

claims.supporting_quote: creates synthetic voices or sound effects to generate remarkably believable fake emergency calls
